Marcus —

Appreciate the heads up and timeline. Short answers up front, followed by proposed compromises so procurement and AP can move forward quickly:

1) PO header and line-item mapping
- We can accept a BU code on each invoice line. Our finance team requires a PO number and a billing entity (legal name / tax id) at the invoice header level. For your setup, the cleanest option is one PO per legal entity with BU codes on lines (that lets your ERP do GL splits).

2) Invoice cadence
- Redwood’s standard for usage-based customers is a consolidated monthly invoice with itemized line entries for daily/weekly usage. We can also provide weekly CSV exports for reconciliation if AP needs weekly detail. We prefer sending a single monthly invoice to avoid excessive invoice churn.

3) Net terms and early-pay
- Standard NET45. For new pilots we can offer a temporary NET60 / NET75 concession but it requires an upfront credit check and approval from Finance.
- As an alternative, we can provide an early-pay discount: 1% if payment is received within 15 days of invoice date. We can tighten that window to 10 days for the pilot if Aureum agrees to the consolidated monthly invoice format and provides the BU-code mapping in the PO header as discussed.

4) Next steps / what we attached
- I’ve attached our Redwood_PO_Template_v2.pdf (includes the PO header sample and the required tax/addr fields).
- Also attached is a short pricing_workbook_april2026.xlsx that shows how BU-line tagging maps back to invoice lines for reporting.

If that sounds reasonable I’d suggest a quick 20-minute call tomorrow to align AP with Finance (Ben) and our billing ops (Grace) so we can get the PO structure confirmed by EOW. If you prefer, confirm the PO sample back by email with the BU codes and whether you want the NET75 credit check route or the NET45 + early-pay discount pilot.

Thanks — happy to be flexible to get you started next week.

Best,

Marcus / Vanessa —

Thanks for the thread. Quick operational proposal from our Billing & Finance side to unblock PO approval this week:

- Invoice cadence: Redwood will issue a consolidated monthly invoice (preferred). We will also push a weekly usage CSV to Aureum's AP mailbox (ap@aureumhealth.com) every Monday morning showing the prior week's runs. That should satisfy ledger automation while keeping AP overhead low.

- PO & BU mapping: Use Vanessa's template. One PO per legal entity (Aureum Health LLC) with BU code on every line item. Our billing engine will accept BU as a custom line field named "BU_CODE" and preserve it on the invoice. Please ensure the PO line value matches one of: CLIN, DATA, INFRA.

- Net terms pilot: We can accept NET75 for the first 90 days (pilot) subject to a soft credit affirmation (no PII required, just a trade-check with our credit ops). After the 90-day pilot we will migrate to NET45 provided billing data aligns and there are no major disputes.

- Early-pay incentive: If Aureum elects to pay within 10 days of invoice, Redwood will apply a 1% credit to the invoice amount (applies to the first three months of the pilot). This is slightly more favorable than Vanessa's initial 15-day window and should preserve your internal AP cadence if you accelerate payments.

- Documentation & next steps:
  1) Marcus — please return the populated PO using Redwood_PO_Template_v2.pdf by Friday EOD with BU codes.
  2) AP — expect weekly CSV exports starting the Monday after the first invoice period; confirm the ap@aureumhealth.com mailbox.
  3) Finance Ops — we will run a soft trade check once we receive the populated PO.

If everyone is aligned I can have Grace issue a short confirmation email and copy the SOW/DocuSign links for signatures so we can hit your next-week target for kickoff.
